title: The Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Second Amendment Rules, 2017
full_text:
# INSURANCE REGULATORY DEVELOPMENT AUTHQR11~ ### ## ., ### ### To Life and General Insurers (Including Standalone Health Insurers) **Sub: The Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Record Amendment Rules, 2017** Central Government vide gazette notification dated 1st June 2017 notified the Prevention Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Second Amendment Rules, 2017 making - The Authority clarifies that, linkage of Aadhaar number to Insurance Policies is mandatory - of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Second 2017. Ph.: 91-040-2338 1100, Fax 91-040-6682 3334
E-mail· lrda@irda.gov.in Web .. www.1rda.gov.1n
